original_sentence: Those who began exercising in middle age also saw reductions in their incidence of chronic diseases, such as heart disease and cancer, which were similar to the steady exercisers.
translation: 那些中年开始锻炼的人，慢性疾病发病率也有所下降，例如心脏病和癌症，其下降情况与长期稳定锻炼者相似。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: in middle age 在本句中对应"在中年时期"。
incidence of chronic diseases 在本句中对应"慢性病发病率"。
steady exercisers 在本句中对应"长期稳定锻炼者"。
begin exercising 在本句中对应"开始锻炼"。
